verdict.rationale: Trello's REST API reference lists a 'Batch' resource, which suggests a first-party way to group many requests into one call. However, the evidence gives only that one-word mention, with no detail on scope, limits, or whether it supports writes (bulk edit, move, archive) rather than reads. Missing for 10: documentation of what Batch can operate on and its limits, evidence of bulk write or modify operations across many cards or boards, any UI or automation bulk-action capability, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
